title: Divide Polynomials
student_objective: I can divide polynomials when the divisor degree does not exceed the dividend degree and verify the quotient by multiplication.
teacher_objective: Diagnose coefficient, exponent, termwise-division, long-division, synthetic-division, missing-term, sign, remainder, and verification errors.

concept_cards.title: Divide monomials
concept_cards.content: Divide coefficients and subtract exponents on like bases: xᵐ÷xⁿ=xᵐ⁻ⁿ when x≠0.

concept_cards.title: Divide every term by a monomial
concept_cards.content: When the divisor is one term, divide each dividend term by that monomial and keep every sign.

concept_cards.title: Use polynomial long division
concept_cards.content: Divide leading terms, multiply, subtract, and bring down. Repeat until the remainder degree is less than the divisor degree.

concept_cards.title: Use placeholders
concept_cards.content: Write a zero-coefficient placeholder for every missing power so terms remain aligned.

concept_cards.title: Check the result
concept_cards.content: Verify dividend=(divisor)(quotient)+remainder. A zero remainder means the divisor is a factor.
